method: Contemporary same-source off/pair/all with frozen tensor/RNG/weights/settings, one warmup and three timed predict_step calls per group; pair/all also compared to pre-review output receipts. Confidence/scorer differences and structural self-consistency are not experimental accuracy. Statistical population units are distinct assemblies, not identical repeats.
reuse: All 156 prior completed calls audited; original feature/RNG/checkpoint/reference/scoring identities retained. Fresh current-source off calls supply contemporary timing controls and confirm parity. Identical repeats are intentional timing replication.
known_limits: Three assemblies, one seed each; no experimental accuracy conclusion.
Model-call timing includes per-call packing/cleanup; load, preprocessing and serialization excluded.
Peak memory is PyTorch allocated memory, not device-level NVML peak.
opt_core cc12.0 fast selections inherit other-architecture table entries; execution/tolerance evidence is distinct from upstream table certification.
Four calls per setting/mode do not establish long-run mixed-shape memory behavior.

guided_chain_symmetry_check.purpose: Check whether the guided label-preserving binder displacement is explained by permuting the two equivalent target chains. No new predictions.

existing_geometry_checks.purpose: Summarize structure-check counters already computed by predict_step; no new prediction or geometry calculation
